## Summary
- Replace cached YouTube playlists with the latest YouTube API response during refresh instead of merging stale entries
- Keep created playlists saved immediately through the existing create flow
- Add Cypress coverage for startup refresh replacing a stale cached playlist with the API result

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#181

## Testing
- npm test -- --runInBand tests/YouTubeUploader.test.ts
- npm run typecheck
- npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/youtube-upload-ui.cy.js (focused local run for "refreshes cached YouTube playlists from the API on app startup")

## Notes
- A full local youtube-upload-ui Cypress spec run still shows unrelated existing settings-sidebar failures where #presetSettingsBtn inherits pointer-events: none; the new playlist refresh test passes when focused.


Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#181
